create.name: Corin Grillo
create.bio:
Corin Grillo is an author and intuitive teacher whose work centres on angels, spirit guides and everyday ritual. A trained psychotherapist by background, she came to angel work through her own practice and now teaches people to ask for help from what she calls their spirit team, with simple daily exercises, channelled audio and plenty of humour. Her first book, The Angel Experiment, sets out a twenty-one-day practice of working with the angels, and Angel Wealth Magic applies the same approach to money, work and home life.

She runs the Inner Sanctum, an online mystery-school community with weekly channelled recordings, monthly live gatherings on Zoom and practice groups for developing intuition. In the foothills of Mount Shasta in northern California she looks after Casa Condor, a retreat house and camping land where she leads private vision quests and small retreats and hosts other groups. She also presents The Corin Grillo Podcast, on spiritual growth, mysticism and awakening, and offers a free seven-day miracle challenge as an introduction to her work.
